scope: Natural-light winter-wheat demonstration, Wofost72_PP; actual rerun of both input cases.
date_basis: Synthetic TMY model dates, not actual historical 2001/2002 weather.

rainfall_limitations: Gridded ERA5 reanalysis, not measured plot rainfall; grid/version equivalence with original PVGIS data is unverified.
Month source years match EPW labels; the resulting stitched series is not a continuous historical crop season.
PVGIS month selection does not establish representative precipitation or drought statistics.
Adapter explicitly selects liquid rain only; snowfall and delayed snowmelt are excluded.
Open-field precipitation is not automatically effective under-panel rainfall; panel runoff redistribution is not represented.
PP mode remains potential production; adding precipitation does not calculate irrigation requirement or dynamic soil storage.

notes: CEVST is crop-module cumulative soil evaporation, distinct from the PP soil-module seasonal EVST.
The published Hao payload hardcodes soil_evaporation_mm=None; this diagnostic reads the raw crop summary instead.
Do not subtract crop transpiration or crop ET from seasonal rain to infer irrigation, retained soil water or drainage.
PP soil water stays at field capacity by assumption; there is no responsive root-zone water balance or irrigation schedule.
Evaporation from zero-rain placeholders is suppressed in the original bridge and is not a valid no-rain field scenario.
Only liquid rainfall is imported; snowmelt and PV rain redistribution are absent.
No real APV shading simulation has been rerun.
